decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix costs little to keep listed and its market prospects are still unclear after one year, so the option stays open, though it is peripheral to the firm's core technology direction.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and are cheap to keep available, and their value has not yet been revealed, so keeping the option is sensible.
As a flagship with its own page and a basis in established capabilities, the waste oil plant is a core option whose uncertainty is still resolving, which justifies continued commitment.
The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship with high but uncertain upside, and early results do not yet show its value is unlikely, so the option is kept open.
